home.rateNote: The rate is computed by planscope fetch-rate as the average of the last 7 complete calendar days (run manually when needed; no weekend backfill, no interpolation, never today's value), written to config/exchange_rate.yaml. CNY prices are always derived; original currency prices are never overwritten. Full method in Methodology.
